text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after I fail to scout Gold City,
I'm
walking along under the
trees, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So, that big fuss out on the course—that
was City, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I think the guy she was arguing with was
her trainer? Seemed pretty
heated.
Wonder if she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't like the sound of that.
I'd better go
take a look!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then, what? You're saying I should just
stop training?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all. It's just,
you don't want to put on too much muscle
and ruin your
proportions, or get any nasty scratches on
your body!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Form is what you should be working on.
Looking pretty while you run is the name
of the game for you. Oh, that and winning
concert
practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so, is any of that gonna help me run
faster? Help me win?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's what you're worried about? It'll be fine. I'll handle it. The trick is, you just gotta run in races you know you can win.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Then there won't be a scratch on your
reputation! The glamorous, the
victorious
Gold City—star of the show! The perfect
plan, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No... No, no, no! That's not who I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tell me... Why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You said... you'd make me the top
Umamusume. That I'd be the
brightest star
on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So why? ...Why are you giving me this
crap?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: What? No, no, my stance hasn't changed. I mean c'mon, you're the Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone talks about you—the cool and
fierce model!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You'll be great. Just leave it all to me!
How to present you, how to
make you
shine—I've got it all figured out.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You just have to do what I say!
It's for your
own good. I mean, that's
what a trainer's
for, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-you again... Why are you...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
And who do you think you are? Why don't
you mind your own
business, huh?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? You got some nerve, pal!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! ...Kid doesn't know what's good for
her. I coulda made her a
star.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Dodged a bullet with that temper, though.
Oh well, plenty of fish in
the sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to make sure she's all right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My search takes me all across campus to
no avail. There's only one
place I haven't
looked...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! What, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You scared me... Seriously, what's going
on? You the paparazzi or
something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain the predicament and ask if she
knows where Gold City could
be.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, you feel the need to find her, why?
...Kinda sus.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know you're trying to scout her,
but like,
you're just after her looks,
aren't you? I
mean, I get it—she's drop dead gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But that means you're like, not any
different from her manager, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So lemme ask you. Why do care about
her?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Support her, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So like, you're gonna do what, exactly,
for
her?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You got nothing?! Wait, like actually? Not
a good look.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only then can I decide what to do—her
input is just as important as
mine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... Well, you do you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
why's it feel like you're waiting for
me to say something? Can
you not?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa there, don't creep any closer!
Nope, not doing this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, again? You've got to be joking!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No! Just, no! And stay away!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew. Should be safe he—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: How are you still following me?! Just get lost already!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Stop! Ugh, I can't with you! Why are you
asking me, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I literally have no idea where she could
be.
I mean, the riverbank, I
guess, but—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, shoot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait a sec!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell her you found out from me,
okay? Seriously, you better not
tell! She's
legit scary when she's mad!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey! Are you listening?!
